PROFILE
Site Reliability Engineer with 7+ years' experience designing, automating and operating cloud infrastructure. Expert in
CI/CD (Azure DevOps/YAML/Github), IaC (Bicep, Terraform), AKS/Docker orchestration, and scripting (PowerShell, Bash,
Python); focused on improving reliability, automating deployments and cost optimization while ensuring security, backups
and operational continuity.
ACCOMPLISHMENTS
Designed and implemented Infrastructure-as-Code (Bicep, Terraform) for Azure environments (AKS, storage,
networking), enabling repeatable provisioning and reducing environment setup time from days to minutes.
Built YAML-based Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines and GitHub workflows to automate build, test and deployment
processes, achieving zero-downtime releases and reducing deployment time by over 70%.
Implemented Monitoring-as-Code with Datadog and robust alerting/runbooks, cutting mean time to recovery (MTTR)
by 40% and reducing incident volume through proactive detection.
Led team with operations, Docker containerization and Helm-based deployments, improving scalability and availability.
Implemented backup, migration and disaster-recovery strategies to meet RTO/RPO targets and maintain 99.9%+
service uptime.
Automated operational tasks with PowerShell, Bash and Python scripts, saving an estimated 15+ hours/week of manual
work.
Optimized Azure costs through tagging, rightsizing and reserved instances, reducing monthly cloud spend by
approximately 20%.
Completely Automated Patching process and DR tests which reduces production downtime.
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
